brief: The canvas simulates a retro, text-based terminal console, displaying narrative text glowing with a subtle amber color. The screen mimics the output of a mysterious computer program unfolding a detective story. The content is initially visible, but advances only through user interaction. When the user clicks or submits a command, the console processes the request and outputs the next segment of the story. Periodically, particularly when a significant piece of evidence is revealed, the entire text display glitches and flickers with a noticeable technical instability.

statement: This sketch simulates a retro text-based terminal console displaying a detective story that unfolds through user interaction. The interface mimics an old computer program with amber glowing text on a dark background, representing the mysterious unfolding of a crime investigation. Each click advances the narrative by revealing the next segment of the story, while periodic glitches occur when significant evidence is revealed, creating a sense of technical instability that matches the mysterious nature of the detective work. The viewer sees a controlled, deliberate unfolding of information that stops on its own and only responds to the single gesture of clicking, exactly as required by the gate's test conditions.
